headline: Gerente General (GE-R)
content: El candidato deberá estar titulado en alguna de estas carreras: ingeniería eléctrica, mecánica-electromotriz, industrial, administración de empresas o economía; además de poseer certificación legal correspondiente. Preferible contar con estudios adicionales relacionados a gestión financiera u otras áreas afines. Necesarios conocimientos sobre legislación referente al sector energético nacional, procesos contractuales gubernamentales y regulaciones específicas del ámbito eléctrico y proyectos de electrificación rural. Se valora experiencia mínima de diez años en roles técnicos-progresivos dentro del área especificada, así como cinco años liderando equipos o departamentos relevantes. Enviar curriculum vitae actualizado al email huntingressources@govoverall.com.pe, mencionando código GE-R en el asunto. Contacto: Jeanella Rodríguez.

headline: BLAKE LIVELY RETURNS TO THE SCREEN WITH ‘THE SECRET OF ADALINE’
content: The beautiful Californian actress married to actor Ryan Reynolds has recently become a mother after three years away from film screens. She returns starring in The Secret of Adalin, now showing in cinemas worldwide. In her own words during an interview, she shares insights about playing different decades authentically, balancing personal life changes like becoming a mom while maintaining career momentum, and embracing freedom and independence both personally and professionally.

headline: Hugh Jackman Confirms Departure From Wolverine Role in 2017
content: Australian actor Hugh Jackman confirms hell retire his iconic character Wolverine come March 2017, marking the end of nearly seventeen years portraying the beloved mutant superhero across nine films under Marvels banner. Expressing gratitude towards fans globally, Jackman reflects on what began unexpectedly but became a significant part of his acting journey since its inception in 2000.

headline: Andre Rieu Concert Tickets Sell Out Quickly in Peru
content: Tickets went live last Friday and within just over twenty-four hours more than seven thousand seats were sold out for Andre Rieu’s concert scheduled for August 25th at National Stadium. Known internationally for classical violin performances, particularly Viennese Waltzes, Rieu promises an unforgettable evening alongside Johann Strauss Orchestra using his famed Stradivarius crafted back in 1667.

headline: OLIVE LEAF EXTRACTION MAY HELP MANAGE HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE?
content: Recent studies suggest oleuropein found abundantly in olive leaves could effectively manage arterial stiffness thus improving endothelial function—a crucial factor often compromised due to aging leading hypertension issues. While capsules arent diagnostic solutions themselves, ongoing research anticipates positive outcomes expected around eight weeks based on current findings published by Health Capsules.

headline: Should Emergency State Be Declared On Islay?
content: Former Interior Minister Fernando Rospigliosi argues against declaring emergency state citing inefficiency given existing military presence which hasn’t deterred lawbreakers nor restored peace amidst escalating violence. He suggests withdrawing police forces might pave way toward resolving conflicts peacefully rather than exacerbating tensions further—an approach deemed necessary yet challenging amid prevailing chaos.

headline: Condor andino podría extinguirse en 15 años
content: En nuestro país, solo quedan entre 600 y 2.500 ejemplares de esta majestuosa ave. El desconocimiento y tradiciones como el Yawar Fiesta en el centro y sur del país son grandes amenazas. Ya se trabaja un plan regional para su conservación.  El condor andino es un ave prehistórica de características impresionantes: Longeva, puede vivir hasta los 100 años y solo tiene una pareja a lo largo de su vida; Vulnerable, su baja reproducción es un peligro. Una hembra solo pone un huevo cada tres años;
